items.name: Apache ActiveMQ
items.description: Open-source message broker that supports messaging protocols such as JMS, enabling reliable asynchronous communication between distributed applications.

items.name: Apache Kafka
items.description: Distributed event streaming platform used to build real-time data pipelines and streaming applications that process high volumes of events.

items.name: Azure Event Grid
items.description: Fully managed event routing service that delivers events from various sources to subscribers, enabling event-driven architectures.

items.name: Azure Event Hubs
items.description: Big data streaming platform and event ingestion service capable of receiving and processing large volumes of events in real time.

items.name: Azure Service Bus
items.description: Fully managed enterprise message broker offering queues and publish-subscribe topics to decouple and connect distributed applications.

items.name: Microsoft BizTalk Server
items.description: Integration server platform used to connect disparate systems, automate business processes, and enable business-to-business communication.

items.name: RabbitMQ
items.description: Open-source message broker that implements protocols like AMQP to enable reliable messaging between distributed applications.
